title: Social
description:
A complete social: one theme applied to an ordered list of frames
on one format.

format.description: The format every frame is laid out on. Absent means portrait.

frames.description:
Frames in swipe order. One frame is a single post; two or more
are a carousel.

outline.description:
The frame titles of the complete social, in order. A preview
social lists more titles than it has frames: the app continues
it from this list later. Leave it empty when the social is
complete.

theme.description: Visual identity applied to every frame.

title.description: Social title, shown in the editor. Not rendered on a frame.

body.description: Family for every other text element that sets no font.

heading.description: Family for text elements with role `title` or `heading`.

Format.description: The canvas a social is laid out on.

Frame.description:
One frame: an HTML fragment for the social's format, CSS for that
fragment, and author notes.

css.description:
CSS for this frame only. The server scopes every selector to
this frame. Use plain selectors such as `.title` or `h1`. Use the
theme through `var(--background)`, `var(--text)`, `var(--accent)`,
`var(--muted)`, `var(--heading-font)`, `var(--body-font)`,
`var(--mono-font)`. No `@import`, no viewport units, no `<`.

html.description:
The frame as one HTML fragment. The canvas is the social's `format` in px: 1080 by 1080 for square, 1080 by 1350 for portrait, 1080 by 1920 for story, 1200 by 630 for landscape. Use px units. Allowed: headings, text, lists, tables, `` with `src="/uploads/{name}"`, inline `
`,
`
`, ``. Not allowed: `

notes.description:
Author notes: the caption to post with the frame, intent, or
handoff remarks. Never rendered on the frame and never exported.

accent.description: Color for highlights, shapes, and chart series that set no color.

background.description: Screen background color when a screen sets no background.

muted.description: Secondary color for captions, rules, and table stripes.

text.description: Text color when an element sets no color.

Theme.description:
Default colors and fonts that elements inherit when they omit their
own.

name.description: Theme name shown in the editor.
